brief: Choose an expense adjustment that respects explicitly stated household constraints.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Adjust within real limits"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Ajusta con límites reales"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Ajuste com limites reais"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Choose an expense adjustment that respects explicitly stated household constraints.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A useful adjustment preserves the needs stated in the situation.
instruction.misconception: Choosing the biggest cut without checking access, health, work or household constraints.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.
